_about: Spectator projection descriptor (List 20 #188). Spectating is a read-only derivation from #10's displayed queue — the same read-only render snapshot the LIVING_FIELD layer receives. The descriptor names a view; it carries no battle state. This fragment instances no session.
battleRef: #187 replay id, or the live battle's record id

neverCrosses: held items not yet named by a queue item in play
any command before it resolves through the queue
either Ranger's private layers (#190 vault, #191 journal)
informationContract.rule: the projection is built from the displayed queue only — hidden state has no path into it
visible: announcements, animscripts, damage, status, cries — the queue as displayed
field presentation: species out, positions, tempo, health bars as displayed

mode: live | replay (#187 playback; inherits its sandbox)
seat: versus: #109 lobby (a spectator is not an entrant; the validator never sees them) | facility: #86 run in progress
spectateDelay: OPEN — live vs delayed is a #109 ruleset slot, proposed into #109's home; identical for every spectator of a match
viewer: licence reference (#98) — a viewer identity for access, never an entrant
writes: NOTHING — no record in the viewer's save or the battle's; attention is not a world fact
